newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA seeks 52,500 tonnes of corn-traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA seeks 52,500 tonnes of corn-traders.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) has tendered for 52,500 tonnes of corn with offers due by 4:00 p.m. (0700 GMT) on Monday, traders said.
Traders said shipment was set for August 6-25 if sourced from the U.S. Gulf, for August 22-September 10 if from the Pacific Northwest or for September 6-25 if from China.
Arrival was scheduled by September 25 to the southeastern ports of Pusan and Ulsan.
